notes.title: The biggest update is here! Wild Roads & Trail Out v2.0!
notes.notes:
Hello drivers! Thanks for your long wait! After 4 months of hard work, we're back with the latest biggest update in Trail Out history! It's [b]Wild Roads[/b] and [b]Trail Out v2.0[/b]! ːMihalychRageː

[previewyoutube=uDPwmVkPUj8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Wild Roads:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Three huge new levels on the island of Madagascar! Race through jungles, beaches, villages, and safaris with animals, all while jumping and avoiding forest fires!
[*] New vehicles: Buggy Bag, Off Rover, Badger, and Bus
[*] Three secret character looks for Woods, Uber, and Mihalych. Find these secret spots on new maps to unlock them!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/391a623efde0502b12764e53afe8c976ee4b0b9f.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Trail Out v2.0:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Redesigned driving, suspension, box, and engine physics. Cars now have weight and inertia and corners can be entered by drifting
[*] Reworked tuning so wheels matter for the surface they best fit
[*] Suspension has several types, both for sport tracks and derby
[*] Opponents in races are more willing to chase you, drive better, and make for improved competition
[*] Hunter Mode has been completely redesigned. Now, you play in a police car with different gadgets to eliminate opponents!
[*] Derbies have become friendlier and opponents have received more balanced damage
[*] [b]Due to an overhaul of car physics and other mechanics, map leaderboards have been reset[/b]
[*] Added small action cameras of enemies when you damage them!
[*] Improved car and driver damage system, now damage looks more brutal and even tears clothes!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/4c5ea7e9a82deec117dc71a35eb9f4687354f09e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/ec6283aa4888025e745902a17e8da3058372f276.gif[/img]

[code][u]Other changes:[/u] 

[list]
[*] All race maps have been updated and new interactive situations have been added (riding vehicles, new objects, or rearranging things)
[*] On the roads, there is a chance of meeting a fan who is trying to take your picture and will run away
[*] Some maps gained a system of day and night.
[*] Garage has a different day and an expanded maximum number of cars it can accommodate
[*] Leaderboards tables have gained the ability to see the car on which the record was set
[*] Leaderboards is now possible to view from the garage, directly in the menu of Free Race
[*] Added sorting cars by class in the garage
[*] A button for fast tuning before the race in the garage was added
[*] Career has been updated to reflect new maps
[*] Improved the effect of the wheels, allowing a car to leave traces on the ground
[*] Tuning of anti-tracking system for cars has been implemented
[*] More data about cars, tuning and maps in the garage
[*] Opponents have learned to answer your car horn or can honk at your back
[*] Cars now have the ability to turn on/off their headlights and some cars have the ability to hide their headlights
[*] Water now has an ejection effect and physical resistance
[*] There are handy tags for new content
[*] Improved interface
[*] Improved Discord status which shows more information
[*] Photo mode has been improved with a graphics enhanced mode button
[*] And many other changes and bug fixes!
[/list][/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/a236aaaa865ce240c0f89e84526ccad334aaa0c2.jpg[/img]

This is the last major free Trail Out update, as per the Roadmap. Unfortunately, due to development difficulties and lack of resources, we are freezing multiplayer development until an indefinite time frame. We'll await the results of the update and focus on porting Trail Out to Playstation 5 and XBox Series S/X consoles. The system requirements for PC have been updated.

With that said, we've prepared the first DLC in the form of cars! [b]Thank you for your attention and support![/b] Have a great time with the new physics and racing under the scorching sun of Madagascar! ːMihalychː

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/0a4de8741b4f7ff03fac3ae8dd67c51f8086ee4f.jpg[/img]

We’re hosting a nightmarishly fun Halloween event alongside Steam’s Scream Fest starting October 25, 2022! Experience Halloween from a new perspective by taking on the role of Trail Out’s very own villain, Frank Woods. In a new experimental event mode, ring in the haunted holiday with Woods’ Nightmare: Redemption!

[b]New In-game Event[/b]
Race into Woods’ Nightmare: Redemption and experience a unique rogue-like addition to the game as well as car combat mode. Explore the eerie open map of Los Angeles where enemies are plentiful and surprises are endless. In this heart-thundering competition, there is no margin for error.

[b]Hellish Enemies[/b]
While you may see some familiar faces, you’ll notice that something is amiss as Halloween has transformed some of Trail Out’s infamous bosses. You’ll have to face them head on and send them back to the hell they spawned from.

[b]Terrifying Weapons[/b]
Take control of a special seasonal car that can be equipped with a variety of unique weapons. Select from sharpened saws and destructive miniguns to full-fledged artillery. The decision is yours.

[b]Trick or Treat [/b]
Receive unique rewards for completing this mode in Trail Out’s main game. Don’t forget to compete for glory on the progression leaderboard!

We are releasing a small update with changes:

- The weight of the machines became more and the damage began to be felt more strongly.
- A new darts trick has become available in the demo, score the most points.
- Enabled physics smoothing depending on FPS, should help players with weak hardware
- The duration of the demo has been increased to two hours.
- The camera has become a little faster, higher and less shaking.
- The stabilization of the car has become better, but more accurate when cornering at high speed, we will rework the settings of the car after the demo.

We are waiting for your new feedback and hope for your understanding that this is the first public beta within the framework of the demo festival, everything can change for the better by the release of the game.
